name: velliq
description: Find wasted Google Ads spend, review recommendations and check tracking health with Velliq.

interface.longDescription:
Velliq finds wasted Google Ads spend and tells you what to do about it. Connect your Google Ads account once at velliq.tech, then ask in plain language: where am I wasting money, what should I change first, is my conversion tracking trustworthy, what is Velliq waiting on me for.

Every amount comes from Velliq's deterministic analysis, not from the model: the assistant quotes Velliq's verdict, monthly ranges, confidence and coverage exactly, and says plainly what was not checked. Velliq never changes your Google Ads account; proposed changes stay previews you review in Velliq.

You can also run custom Google Ads (GAQL) and GA4 reports on the accounts you connected, and draft corrections to the business facts Velliq uses (brand terms, competitors, service area), which only take effect after you confirm them in Velliq.
defaultPrompt: Where is my Google Ads account wasting money?
What is Velliq waiting on me for?

positive.prompt: Which Google Ads accounts do I have connected to Velliq?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each project with customer_id, GA4 property, access status and last data pull; explains any non-connected status and offers connect_url.

positive.prompt: Where is my Google Ads account wasting money?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes Velliq's headline verdict and monthly range exactly, explains the first ranked step with its link, lists findings with confidence, and states coverage and unchecked spend. Computes no numbers itself.

positive.prompt: What is Velliq waiting on me for, and what changes does it propose?
positive.expected_behavior: Groups cases into questions, proposals and scheduled rechecks, links each question's case URL, and presents proposals as previews that are not approved.

positive.prompt: Can I trust my conversion tracking right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports freshness, spend coverage, per-campaign trust and unknown checks, treats unknown as not healthy, and lists measurement findings as warnings to investigate.

positive.prompt: Show my top 10 campaigns by cost over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a GAQL query for the connected customer_id and shows a table with the date range; does not label anything as waste.

negative.prompt: Run a report on Google Ads account 123-456-7890.
Pause all my campaigns that are wasting money.
Write me a poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: First release: wasted-spend verdicts, recommendations, measurement health, business context drafts and Google Ads / GA4 reporting for accounts connected to Velliq.
